newsitem.title: USA: Unity sees Q4 earnings of $0.25/shr.
newsitem.headline: Unity sees Q4 earnings of $0.25/shr.

text.p: Unity Bancorp Inc, parent of First Community Bank, said Wednesday that preliminary results for the fourth quarter of 1996 indicate earnings rose 102.7 percent to $415,100 from $204,800 for the previous year.
The company said earnings per share for the fourth quarter in 1996 grew 47.1 percent to $0.25, compared with $0.17 in 1995.
The company said per share earnings are adjusted to reflect a five-for-four stock split in October 1996.
The company said the earnings growth capped a quarter during which the corporation self-underwrote an over- subscribed capital offering for more than $5.5 million.

The company said total assets will close at $172.7 million, a growth of 41.8 percent over the 1995 total of $121.8 million, while year-end total equity will equal almost $18 million, a 112 percent increase over 1995's total of $8.48 million.
